b2-sporttortenet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hajós Alfréd's Victory
b2-sporttortenet-01.scenario: At a swimming pool on Margaret Island, an old coach asks you what you know about Hajós Alfréd.
b2-sporttortenet-01.prompt: Tell the coach what Hajós Alfréd won in Athens in 1896 and how cold the water was.
cues: Say what he won in Athens
Say how cold the water was and what he did about it
b2-sporttortenet-01.target: Hajós Alfréd 1896-ban Athénban két aranyérmet nyert. A víz olyannyira hideg volt, hogy zsírral kente be a testét.
b2-sporttortenet-01.english: In 1896 Alfréd Hajós won two gold medals in Athens. The water was so cold that he smeared his body with fat.
b2-sporttortenet-01.canDo: I can narrate the career of Alfréd Hajós as Hungary's first Olympic champion (Athens 1896) and renowned architect.

b2-sporttortenet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Sabres and Water Polo
b2-sporttortenet-02.scenario: At a sports club in Budapest, a young coach asks you why Hungarian sabre fencing and water polo were so successful.
b2-sporttortenet-02.prompt: Tell the coach what the Hungarian sabre team won and how the water polo players played.
cues: Say how many team golds the sabre fencers won in a row
Say how the water polo players treated their opponents
b2-sporttortenet-02.target: A magyar kardvívók hét olimpiai csapataranyérmet nyertek zsinórban. A pólósok gyors passzokkal leúszták az ellenfeleket.
b2-sporttortenet-02.english: The Hungarian sabre fencers won seven Olympic team gold medals in a row. The water polo players out-swam their opponents with fast passes.
b2-sporttortenet-02.canDo: I can say what made Hungarian sabre fencing and water polo so successful.

b2-sporttortenet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Match at Wembley
b2-sporttortenet-03.scenario: In a café in Budapest, a friend who loves football asks you about the famous match in London.
b2-sporttortenet-03.prompt: Tell your friend when the match was and how it ended, and say how the Hungarians played.
cues: Say the date and the result
Say how far the Hungarians dominated the game
b2-sporttortenet-03.target: 1953. november 25-én a magyar válogatott 6:3-ra nyert Wembleyben. A magyarok olyan mértékben uralták a játékot, hogy hat gólt lőttek.
b2-sporttortenet-03.english: On 25 November 1953 the Hungarian national team won 6:3 at Wembley. The Hungarians dominated the game to such an extent that they scored six goals.
b2-sporttortenet-03.canDo: I can tell the story of the 6:3 match at Wembley on 25 November 1953.

b2-sporttortenet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Match in Melbourne
b2-sporttortenet-04.scenario: At an exhibition about 1956, a visitor asks you what happened in the water polo match in Melbourne.
b2-sporttortenet-04.prompt: Tell the visitor who played whom, when, and why the referees stopped the match.
cues: Say who played whom and on which day
Say what the score was when the referees stopped the match
b2-sporttortenet-04.target: 1956. december 6-án a magyar vízilabdázók Melbourne-ben a szovjet csapattal játszottak. A magyarok 4:0-ra vezettek, amikor a bírók lefújták a mérkőzést.
b2-sporttortenet-04.english: On 6 December 1956 the Hungarian water polo players played the Soviet team in Melbourne. The Hungarians led 4:0 when the referees stopped the match.
b2-sporttortenet-04.canDo: I can tell what happened in the water polo match between Hungary and the Soviet Union in Melbourne on 6 December 1956.

b2-sporttortenet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Sports Nation
b2-sporttortenet-05.scenario: A foreign friend who is visiting Budapest asks you what the word sportnemzet means.
b2-sporttortenet-05.prompt: Explain the word to your friend and name one Hungarian Olympic champion.
cues: Name one champion and say how many Olympic titles she won
b2-sporttortenet-05.target: A sportnemzet azt a meggyőződést fejezi ki, hogy egy kis ország is elérhet nagy sikereket. Egerszegi Krisztina ötszörös olimpiai bajnok.
b2-sporttortenet-05.english: Sports nation expresses the belief that even a small country can achieve great success. Krisztina Egerszegi is a five-time Olympic champion.
b2-sporttortenet-05.canDo: I can say what sportnemzet means and name modern Hungarian Olympic champions.

b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Milestones of Hungarian Sport
b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a sports-history tour in Budapest, the guide asks you to name two milestones.
b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.prompt: Name one milestone from 1896 and one from 1953.
b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.target: Hajós Alfréd 1896-ban olimpiai bajnok lett. 1953-ban a magyar válogatott 6:3-ra nyert Wembleyben.
b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.english: Alfréd Hajós became an Olympic champion in 1896. In 1953 the Hungarian national team won 6:3 at Wembley.
b2-sporttortenet-consolidation.canDo: I can summarize the major milestones of Hungarian sports history from Alfréd Hajós to modern champions.
